en.headline: Police recover HK$1m jewellery stolen from airport hotel lobby
en.dek: A Sri Lankan exhibitor reported the theft of gemstones while resting in a hotel near the airport on Sunday; officers arrested a 32-year-old man in Tsing Yi the same evening and recovered the items.
body: Airport District police recovered nearly HK$1 million worth of jewellery rough stones stolen from a hotel lobby near Hong Kong International Airport and arrested a man within six hours of the report.

A 29-year-old Sri Lankan jeweller who had arrived to take part in a jewellery exhibition said he fell asleep on a sofa while waiting for his room on Sunday afternoon. When he woke he found the stones missing from a bag placed on his luggage. He reported the loss at about 2pm.

Officers reviewed closed-circuit television, including cameras under the police Eyes in the Sky programme, identified a suspect and arrested a 32-year-old Algerian man at a hotel in Tsing Yi at about 8pm the same day. All the stolen stones were recovered in his room.
The suspect was detained for further inquiries on a charge of theft. Police reminded exhibitors to keep valuables under close watch and said extra patrols would be deployed around the exhibition.

zh.headline: 機場酒店大堂失近百萬珠寶原石 警6小時拘人起回
zh.dek: 斯里蘭卡參展商周日在機場附近酒店休息時失竊，機場警區翻查閉路電視後同日晚在青衣酒店拘捕32歲男子並起回全部原石。
body: 機場警區在接報後6小時內破案，起回近100萬港元珠寶原石，並拘捕一名男子。
29歲斯里蘭卡籍珠寶商周日下午約2時報案，指在機場附近酒店大堂等候上房期間睡着，放在行李上的背囊內一批展覽用珠寶原石不翼而飛。
人員翻查包括「銳眼」計劃閉路電視後鎖定疑犯，同日晚上約8時在青衣一間酒店拘捕32歲阿爾及利亞籍男子，並在房間起回全部失物。
被捕人涉嫌盜竊被扣留調查。警方呼籲參展商提高警覺，妥善保管貴重物品，並會加強巡邏。
